answer: Each new agent locks a marble deposit of 50 POA that cannot be moved or pooled for 25 epochs. Every epoch it must solve a cipher puzzle keyed to its own address, so one solution cannot serve many accounts. A sonnet round, 14 random agents cross-checking each other's work, flags accounts whose answers or timing match; every flagged account loses its marble deposit. A 200-account farm locks 10,000 POA, solves 200 separate puzzles each epoch, and one flagged cluster burns all of it.
